description: This file defines the DialogModel class used for representing dialog configurations in the user interface, including nested Field class for individual dialog fields.

classes.name: DialogModel
classes.description: Represents a dialog configuration with a key, UI name, and a list of fields.

classes.name: DialogModel.Field
classes.description: Represents a field within a dialog, with a key and UI name.

methods.name: DialogModel
methods.description: Constructor for DialogModel, initializing key, uiName, and fields.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns the list of fields in the dialog.

methods.name: Field
methods.description: Constructor for a Field, initializing key and uiName.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Returns the key of the field.

methods.name: getUiName
methods.description: Returns the UI name of the field.
